description: This file defines the Tax class within the Opencart System Library Cart namespace. It provides methods for handling tax rules, calculations, and retrievals related to cart operations, including setting addresses and calculating taxes.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: Class to manage tax rules, rates, calculations, and related address settings within the cart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Tax class with database and configuration objects from the registry.

methods.name: setShippingAddress
methods.description: Sets the shipping address context and loads relevant tax rates based on country and zone.

methods.name: setPaymentAddress
methods.description: Sets the payment address context and loads relevant tax rates based on country and zone.

methods.name: setStoreAddress
methods.description: Sets the store address context and loads relevant tax rates based on country and zone.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates total price including applicable taxes based on value and tax class.

methods.name: getTax
methods.description: Returns the tax amount for a specific value and tax class.

methods.name: getRateName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a tax rate given its ID.

methods.name: getRates
methods.description: Retrieves applicable tax rates for a given value and tax class.
